sets.name: Wayfarer Compact
sets.identity: Neutral exploration gear for scouts who stitch old roads, waymarks, and safe camps into one route plan.
sets.source_hint: Guarded road caches and authored region reward chains; explicitly opted-in common pickups execute their bounded source table.

piece_thresholds.summary: The paired road tools keep the expedition moving between established waymarks.
The complete compact reveals one additional ring of nearby terrain.

sets.name: Asterfall Survey
sets.identity: A field astronomer's command kit for reading stormlight, fixing distant routes, and bringing a measured charge onto uncertain ground.
sets.source_hint: The complete survey is placed across the Halo Refraction expedition, while guarded artifact sites can yield individual pieces.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two calibrated survey pieces hold a cleaner marching line between distant bearings.
The complete survey reads one ring farther and times the opening command to the falling light.

sets.name: Lockward Charter
sets.identity: An Embercourt field charter that funds the crossing, answers the lock signal, and holds the opened road.
sets.source_hint: The complete charter is fixed across Causeway Stand's three artifact pickups.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two charter instruments steady the line while the crossing is opened.
The complete charter keeps the column moving beyond the secured lock.

ui.alt_text: A broken hexagonal lock gate surrounds a hooded beacon and crossed bridge keys.

sets.name: Fenhound Pursuit
sets.identity: A Mireclaw hunting kit that crosses drowned ground, sounds the pack, and closes on a fresh trail.
sets.source_hint: The complete pursuit kit is fixed across Bogbound Oath's three artifact pickups.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two pursuit pieces synchronize the pack's opening rush.
The complete pursuit reads the trail and drives the attack home.

ui.alt_text: An open fenhound jaw curves around a hanging scent bell and three reed blades.

sets.name: Meridian Relay
sets.identity: A Sunvault calibration array that turns prism warding, command timing, and measured resistance into one relay.
sets.source_hint: The complete relay is fixed across Prismhearth Watch's three artifact pickups.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two calibrated pieces spread hostile magic across a steadier prism lattice.
The complete relay finds the next line of sight and answers at the exact moment.

ui.alt_text: A tall diamond prism hangs inside broken meridian rings beneath a sharp noon ray.

sets.name: Rootpath Covenant
sets.identity: A Thornwake living-road covenant that roots the line, follows buried paths, and grows a route beyond sight.
sets.source_hint: The complete covenant is fixed across Mireford Skirmish's three artifact pickups.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two living pieces knit a harder defensive root line.
The complete covenant extends the root road beyond the visible frontier.

ui.alt_text: A split seed rises from three braided roots beneath an antler-like briar crown.

sets.name: Redline Survey Warrant
sets.identity: A Brasshollow field warrant that measures the advance, plates the halt, and authorizes pressure at the red line.
sets.source_hint: The complete warrant is fixed across Orevein Contract's three artifact pickups.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two certified pieces reinforce the surveyed halt.
The complete warrant advances on pressure and seizes the opening beat.

ui.alt_text: A square cog warrant frames a pressure gauge with a hard diagonal needle and survey arms.

sets.name: Drowned Wake Chart
sets.identity: A Veilmourn wreck chart that fixes a route through fog, sounds the hazard, and carries the command across wet ground.
sets.source_hint: The complete chart is fixed across Bellwake Wreck Claim's three artifact pickups.

piece_thresholds.summary: Two wake pieces read one farther ring through fog and spray.
The complete chart keeps the command moving and answers the bell before the hazard closes.

ui.alt_text: Two black ship ribs enclose a pale drowned star and cracked hanging wake bell.

items.name: Trailsinger Boots

ui.summary: Common roadfinder boots for movement, scouting, and Beacon route tempo.

items.description: Soft-soled boots traced with old road songs. They stretch a march and sharpen a scout's read of the road ahead.

spell_modifiers.public_summary: Beacon field route spells cost 1 less mana and restore 1 more movement.

items.name: Quarry Tally Rod

ui.summary: Common surveyor trinket for gold and ore income.

items.description: A brass counting rod used by frontier surveyors to squeeze one more cart from every shift.

items.name: Warcrest Pennon

ui.summary: Uncommon command banner for attack and initiative.

items.description: A compact command pennon whose bright crest sharpens charges and keeps the line moving.

items.name: Bastion Gorget

ui.summary: Uncommon armor for defensive command.

items.description: Layered bronze plate forged for siege marshals. It steadies the front under punishing blows.

items.name: Waymark Compass

ui.summary: Wayfarer Compact trinket for route scouting and set progress.

items.description: A low brass compass whose needle settles only after nearby stones, camps, and old mile cuts agree.

items.name: Milepost Lantern

ui.summary: Wayfarer Compact lantern for movement, short scouting, and set progress.

items.description: A hooded lantern with mile cuts around its rim. It turns camp light into a practical marching line.

items.name: Tollstone Ring

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Adds daily gold, wood, and Embergrain income from public route work.

ui.summary: Embercourt-aligned toll ring for road, Embergrain, and town income.

items.description: A river-worn oath ring used to tally bridge dues and keep repair crews paid before the road forgets its charter.

items.name: Mudglass Beads

ui.summary: Mireclaw-aligned bead string for harrying tempo, attack command, and Peatwax income.

items.description: Opaque beads hardened in blackwater channels. They click like teeth when a wounded route is ready to close.

items.name: Choir Tuning Fork

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Improves resistance to Lens school magic.

ui.summary: Sunvault-aligned tuning tool for calibrated sight, spell resistance, and Aetherglass income.

items.description: A split crystal fork that steadies relay crews by pitch instead of command. In silence it points toward glare.

items.name: Living Bridge Knot

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Adds daily wood and Verdant Grafts from careful graft tending.

ui.summary: Thornwake-aligned graft knot for living routes, wood, and Verdant Grafts.

items.description: A thumb-sized knot of patient bridgewood, bound with pilgrim thread and still deciding which road deserves shade.

items.name: Pressure Gauge Reliquary

ui.summary: Brasshollow-aligned gauge relic for armor timing, command tempo, and Brass Scrip income.

items.description: A sealed gauge carried like a chapel icon. Its needle climbs before armor crews admit the heat is dangerous.

items.name: Black-Sail Compass

ui.summary: Veilmourn-aligned compass for fog scouting, salvage routes, and Memory Salt income.

items.description: A lacquered ship compass that refuses north but remembers which fog bank last hid a wreck.

items.name: Rainstar Sextant

ui.summary: Uncommon survey instrument for scouting and opening-command timing.

items.description: A brass field sextant whose suspended rain-glass brightens when a distant road lies under clear sky.

items.name: Asterfall Mantle

ui.summary: Uncommon navigator's mantle for defense and sustained field movement.

items.description: Layered midnight weathercloth weighted with pale meteor glass, cut for surveyors who keep marching through the first hard rain.

items.name: Cometwake Pennon

ui.summary: Rare expedition pennon for attack and decisive command tempo.

items.description: A split-tail survey pennon set with cloudy glass. Its falling-star line gives the advance a bearing even when no horizon is visible.

items.name: Bridgefire Standard

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Adds 50 gold each day from chartered bridge dues.

ui.summary: Embercourt field standard for attack command and steady charter income.

items.description: A compact red-gold field standard lit by a hooded bridge lantern. Its charter seals promise the column a paid road home.

items.name: Reedshadow Waders

ui.summary: Mireclaw marsh boots for route tempo and the first strike.

items.description: Black reed-fiber waders lacquered against bogwater, with hooked soles that find purchase where a causeway has already drowned.

items.name: Prismward Mantle

ui.summary: Sunvault mantle for defensive command and spell resistance.

items.description: A white-gold command mantle sewn with narrow aetherglass scales that turn hostile workings aside in brief bands of daylight.

items.name: Graftbark Cuirass

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Adds 1 wood each day from tended graftwood.

ui.summary: Thornwake living armor for defense and a steady graftwood supply.

items.description: A fitted cuirass of overlapping bark plates. Its green seams harden under blows and shed viable cuttings beside a patient campfire.

items.name: Quenchplate Vambrace

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Adds 1 ore each day from certified salvage.

ui.summary: Brasshollow plated armguard for defense and certified ore salvage.

items.description: A heavy brass-and-blacksteel vambrace stamped with inspection clauses; every repaired plate is entered twice and wasted never.

items.name: Fogwake Deckboots

ui.summary: Veilmourn deck boots for sustained movement and fog-route scouting.

items.description: Salt-black deck boots with pale bell-metal cleats. On wet stone they leave a brief wake pointing toward the nearest clear passage.

items.name: Lockflame Writ Banner

ui.summary: Embercourt lock-bridge standard for holding a line and answering the signal quickly.

items.description: A forked road writ hung beneath a hooded lock-lantern. Its wax clauses glow whenever the bearer braces a contested crossing.

items.name: Mirechain Hunt Totem

ui.summary: Mireclaw hunt totem for a faster opening and more vicious first strike.

items.description: A hooked reedwood totem burdened with ferry chain, horn, and wet hide. Its bone clappers sound just before a mire hunt breaks cover.

items.name: Zenith Prism Pennon

ui.summary: Sunvault calibration pennon for measured initiative and spell resistance.

items.description: An ivory calibration frame suspends a split pennon beneath a turning zenith prism. Commanders time their advance by its orbiting points of light.

items.name: Briarcrown Covenant Standard

ui.summary: Thornwake living standard for a rooted line that keeps growing down the road.

items.description: A living standard grafted around a seed-cairn and thorn halo. Its leafcloth tightens against blows while its roots feel for the next roadbed.

items.name: Redline Warrant Gonfalon

ui.summary: Brasshollow pressure warrant for disciplined attack and plated defense.

items.description: A segmented iron gonfalon built around a sealed pressure gauge. Its warrant plates authorize the line to advance exactly to the red mark and hold.

items.name: Wakebell Mourning Ensign

ui.summary: Veilmourn wreck ensign for prompt response and one farther ring of fog-route sight.

items.description: Torn sailcloth hangs between black ship ribs beneath a cracked wake bell. Its fog lantern marks hazards before the mourning note reaches them.

items.name: Lockward Beacon Key

ui.summary: Embercourt route key for reaching the next lock quickly and holding it once opened.

items.description: A bridge-lock key built through a hooded route lantern and weighted with sealed writs. The beacon warms as the next defensible crossing draws near.

items.name: Fenhound Scent Bell

ui.summary: Mireclaw scent bell for finding prey through fog and striking before the trail cools.

items.description: A wet-bronze bell lashed beneath a carved fenhound jaw. Its bone clappers answer only when a fresh trail crosses the commander's route.

items.name: Meridian Relay Lens

ui.summary: Sunvault relay lens for precise timing and measured resistance to hostile magic.

items.description: A diamond lens turns inside nested meridian rings between mirrored sighting vanes. Its noon-point clicks one breath before hostile magic lands.

items.name: Rootpath Seed Compass

ui.summary: Thornwake living compass for following root roads beyond the visible frontier.

items.description: A split seed turns within a fork of living roots, pointing its leaf needle toward old roadbeds hidden beneath the frontier.

items.name: Redline Survey Dial

ui.summary: Brasshollow survey dial for setting a hard marching line and holding it under pressure.

items.description: A riveted survey gauge with folding sight arms and a furnace-fed redline needle. It marks the farthest safe advance and the strongest place to stop.

items.name: Drowned-Star Astrolabe

ui.summary: Veilmourn astrolabe for reading drowned routes and answering their hazards quickly.

items.description: A pale drowned-star shard hangs within salt-pitted rings, a cracked wake bell, and a fogglass plumb. It points toward hazards before the mist reveals them.

items.name: Lockfire Assize Seal

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Strengthens the command line around a defended crossing.

ui.summary: An Embercourt capstone seal for fortified command and dependable Embergrain levies.

items.description: A river-court seal locked inside miniature sluice gates. Its ember cannot be taxed, dimmed, or carried across a false writ.

items.name: Miremoon Hunt Drum

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Drives the company into a stronger opening assault.
Sharpens the first beat of the hunt.

ui.summary: A Mireclaw hunt drum for attack tempo, initiative, and patient Peatwax gathering.

items.description: Wax-dark hide spans a crescent jaw frame. Its low beat tells every reed hunter which ripple belongs to prey.

items.name: Noonglass Orrery

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Turns hostile spell angles away from the formation.

ui.summary: A Sunvault capstone instrument for spell resistance, initiative, and Aetherglass calibration.

items.description: An open wheel of noon-glass discs that refuses every false horizon. A forked arm clicks once when a spell enters its true angle.

items.name: Worldroot Covenant Heartwood

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Roots the battle line against displacement.
Opens living shortcuts across the field.

ui.summary: A Thornwake heartwood cuirass for defense, living-road movement, and Verdant Grafts.

items.description: A heart-shaped plate cut from a root that remembers the first covenant. Seed sockets along its rim open whenever the bearer chooses a living road.

items.name: Seventh-Clause Pressure Key

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Authorizes a measured increase in battle pressure.
Locks the formation inside safe tolerances.

ui.summary: A Brasshollow master key balancing attack, defense, and Brass Scrip income.

items.description: Seven uneven teeth turn a gauge wheel instead of a lock. The final tooth bears a seal no foundry clerk is permitted to copy.

items.name: Last-Bell Tideglass

bonus_metadata.public_summary: Reads distant routes in the fall of black tideglass.
Marks the last safe moment to act.

ui.summary: A Veilmourn tideglass for deep scouting, decisive timing, and Memory Salt recovery.

items.description: Black grains fall inside a cracked tideglass hung from a silent bell frame. Salt beads climb upward when an unseen road is about to close.
